name: Granola
desc: Bot-free AI meeting notepad that merges your own notes
desc_zh: 不加会议机器人的 AI 笔记，用你的手写笔记与转录合并成纪要
solves: Meeting bots join as a participant and record everyone. Granola sits in your notes app and turns your own scrawl plus the transcript into clean notes.
solves_zh: 会议机器人以参会者身份入场，把所有人都录了。Granola 待在你的笔记应用里，把你自己写的东西加上转录整理成干净记录。
best_for: When you already take your own notes and don't want another voice in the room.
best_for_zh: 当你自己已经在记笔记，不想房间里再多一个声音。
